goal: Server-side filters, KPIs and the shared cached view (F1, K1, D1 part 2; Board gate 175: one value per column, filters AND, >50-distinct columns not categorical so no filter, KPIs follow the filters)

acceptance_criteria.text: New app/filters.py: parse(params, columns, mapping) -> hashable tuple of (name, value) pairs: f.<column>=value for categorical columns only (empty value, unknown or non-categorical column ignored; repeated key keeps the last), then from, then to (valid date.fromisoformat on a dataset with a temporal column, else ignored, re-printed ISO); apply(f, columns, mapping, typed) -> kept row indexes or None when f == (); rows with an empty or unparseable time are dropped as soon as from or to is set; labels (e.g. 'region = North', 'date from 2024-01-01'); summary(labels) -> 'Filters: a; b' or 'Filters: none'; options(columns, rows, mapping) -> {categorical column: sorted distinct non-empty str values, <= 50}

_base also returns options; new @lru_cache(maxsize=8) _view(d, f) returns rows, mapping, options, filters, labels, charts (rules.charts on the filtered typed rows) and kpis; column types stay those of the unfiltered rows

New rules.kpis(columns, rows, typed, mapping) -> {'rows', 'columns', 'missing_pct' (round(100*empty/(rows*columns), 1), 0 when no cells; empty = None or ''), 'sums': [{'column', 'sum'}] for the first 3 numerical columns, int when whole else round(s, 2)}

GET /api/datasets/<id>/charts and the dashboard page call _view with filters.parse(request.query_params, ...); the charts API response gains 'kpis' and 'filters' (label list); with no params everything else answers as before; the page route passes view keys (kpis, options, labels, filters, a canonical query string) to the template without changing the template

sales.csv: ?f.region=North gives kpis.rows 3 and amount sum 16 and every chart total smaller than unfiltered; ?from=2024-01-03&to=2024-01-05 gives kpis.rows 3; unfiltered kpis Rows 6, Columns 3, missing_pct 0.0, amount sum 46; a column with more than 50 distinct values or an unknown f.column is ignored; a donut on the filtered column is simply not generated

decisions.what: Filter pair names are 'f.<column>', 'from', 'to'; labels strip the 'f.' prefix
decisions.why: Matches the architecture's canonical query string (urlencode(f)) and avoids a clash with columns named from/to

decisions.what: apply compares ISO date strings and uses rules._time on the temporal cell
decisions.why: Works on typed or raw rows, and rows with a None time are dropped as soon as from or to is set

decisions.what: options caps each list at 50 values (sorted()[:50])
decisions.why: Classify looks at the first 10,000 rows only, so later rows could add more distinct values; the ticket says <= 50

decisions.what: Exports keep a _charts(d) helper that reads _view(d, ()); exports are not filtered yet
decisions.why: The ticket covers only the charts API and the page; the exports ticket comes later

decisions.what: kpis sums use _num on typed cells and _clean on the total; non-finite sums become None
decisions.why: int(inf) would raise and inf is not JSON-safe

assumptions: A categorical cell that is None compares as the string 'None' in apply (same str() key the bars use), and is never listed in options
